status_definitions.Recorded: administratively preserved but not independently validated
status_definitions.Observed: directly seen in a primary artifact, live state, or authoritative source
status_definitions.Externally verified: checked against a named authoritative source at the recorded time
status_definitions.Reproduced: independently repeated under the same bounded conditions
status_definitions.Validated: evidence supports the proposition and material alternatives were checked
status_definitions.Retested: the original validation was repeated after remediation
status_definitions.Rejected: evidence did not support the proposition
status_definitions.Uncertain: evidence is incomplete; no definitive claim is made

last_transition.statement: Release the activation hold for the already approved G1 local lab scope; G2 remains closed.
